t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.agn: Restricted in the EU under REACH: at 0.1% by weight or more it has been banned in rinse-off products since 31 January 2020 and will be banned in leave-on products from 6 June 2027 (EU 2024/1328). The reason for the restriction is persistence in the environment. It is on the EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group B).
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.eff.0: Restricted in the EU because it is persistent in the environment and accumulates in living organisms; the reason is not human health.
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.eff.1: Listed among substances to be assessed by the EU for possible effects on the hormone system.
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.k3.0: EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group B). It is also restricted under REACH (because of its persistence in the environment).
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.k3.1: EU REACH restriction. At 0.1% by weight or above: banned in rinse-off products from 31 January 2020 (D4, D5) and in leave-on products from 6 June 2027.
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.k3.2: Türkiye – draft regulation. According to news reports, in Türkiye it will not be allowed to be placed on the market in hair spray, sunscreen, moisturiser and foundation from 31 December 2026.
t.CYCLOPENTASILOXANE.what: Helps the product spread easily, then evaporates and leaves a silky feel on skin and hair.
